text:
Artturi Lehkonen has 12 goals in 18 games, and nearly all of them came early. He scored his 12th on Oct. 31 against Calgary and has gone four games without a point since, with the chances thinning out too.

He has 7.3 expected goals (the quality of his chances) and is shooting 32%, against 14% last season. Colorado has also scored 9.0 more goals than expected with him on the ice. Our numbers flag him as due to cool, and the last four games may be that starting.

None of that makes him a bad player. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 7.0 scoring chances per 60 from the slot last season, 90th percentile, and 27% of his setups came from behind the net. He gets to the right ice.

The headlines have already moved to money: NHLRumors.com asked whether he is pricing himself out of Colorado. Our range has him at 26 to 41 goals.
headline: Lehkonen's 12 goals came fast. The next ones won't
